applicationEvidence.reason: The real search rendered a source-qualified code/name, road, neighbourhood, city and region plus independent CM AGID ID. This is more detailed than the country and postcode layers, but the Photon result is ambiguous and is not asserted as an authoritative building-footprint relation. The unmocked CM postal API failed closed and no postal Polygon/MultiPolygon or translucent postal overlay existed, matching the current no-postcode system.

limitations: Current no-postcode evidence excludes CM from postcode data creation.
BP and numeric P.O.-box identifiers are delivery-address components, not postcode membership.
The detailed Photon result and AGID identity are independent context, not an authoritative building relation.
UPU and Cameroon government references are not open bulk datasets.
Hugging Face, libpostal, OSM and the draft pack are not postal authority.
Deterministic rendering is not reported as manual visual inspection.
